author: Shrimpy
body:
Greetings Avicus Members, 

I have my fair share of enjoyment on your servers. I have about 70 hours worth of time on your servers and lots more time before this actually became Avicus. However, recently while playing Nexus, I was banned for "hacking" even though I wasn't. One of your moderators: 'Sulorak' accused me of hacking and banned me instantly without giving me a chance to explain. 

This was our "conversation":
======================================
Sulorak: TheBron_cool
TheBron_cool: yeah
Sulorak: Hacking isn't allowed on Avicus servers!
======================================
She banned me there. I checked my profile; it says I was banned for Killaura and fast-bow...

I am extremely disappointed on how people moderate these games. No one else on the server accused me of hacking until Sulorak showed up and did it herself. 

Apparently being good at something means I shouldn't be allowed to play it. NEVER IN MY LIFE would I think hacking is acceptable or even fun for me or for others. I've been doing pvp, and Minecraft in general, for over 2 years and I know a hacker when I see one. I've reported hackers in the past. You won't see me hacking but instead someone who just wants to have fun on your servers just like anyone else. I CAN ASSURE YOU my MC client is clean, with the exception of Optifine. 

On my YouTube channel, I have a very recent video from a few days ago of me playing Nexus on your servers reporting hackers. As you will see I am at least trying to enjoy your servers while doing a good deed, if you will. You can see it at the bottom of this post. I also have another video of my friend and me enjoying your server.

An unban would be greatly appreciated.


Yours truly, 
Bronson a.k.a. TheBron_cool

The video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P4VyVe2cpNI&list=UUl6Cj1Cabp9HswReYlUwrIQ
